newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rohm probes possibility of LSI development in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Rohm probes possibility of LSI development in Asia.

text.p: Rohm Co Ltd said on Thursday it would form a subsidiary in Taiwan in July and may develop large-scale integrated circuits (LSIs) there in the future.

The new Taiwanese unit and a liaison office set up in Bangalore in March will study the LSI business in the two areas and probe the possibility of developing LSIs there in the future, a company spokesman said.
The company to be set up in Taiwan will be capitalised at NT$100 million and will be owned nearly 100 percent by Rohm Electronics Asia Pte Ltd in Singapore, he said.
The Singapore subsidiary supervises Rohm's business in Asia, the company said.

Although the spokesman did not comment on the possibility of upgrading the Bangalore office to a research and development subsidiary, he said, "India is considered Asia's Silicon Valley and a design centre for LSIs. Not only Japanese companies but European and U.S. companies are also setting up offices there."
